mapper.select: WITH RECURSIVE sub_tree AS ( SELECT id FROM bf_file_item WHERE id = #{folderId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' UNION ALL SELECT c.id FROM bf_file_item c JOIN sub_tree s ON c.parent_id = s.id WHERE c.status = 'ACTIVE' ) SELECT COALESCE(SUM(size_bytes), 0) FROM bf_file_item WHERE id IN (SELECT id FROM sub_tree) AND item_type = 'FILE'
